name: llm-translate
title: LLM Translate
description: Translate selected text with a fast, cheap LLM via OpenRouter — replacement for the built-in Google translation.
author: danielbrammertz

commands.name: translate-selection
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.description: Translate the selected text (falls back to clipboard) and show the result as a pill at the bottom of the screen — like the built-in translator.

preferences.name: pillDuration
preferences.title: Pill Duration
preferences.description: How long the translation pill stays on screen

commands.name: translate-selection-window
commands.title: Translate Selection (Window)
commands.description: Translate the selected text in a full Raycast window with paste/copy actions — better for long texts.

commands.name: dictionary-lookup
commands.title: Dictionary Lookup
commands.description: Type a word or short phrase in a native prompt and show its distinct meanings/senses as a pill, like a bilingual dictionary.

preferences.name: pillDuration
preferences.title: Pill Duration
preferences.description: How long the dictionary pill stays on screen

preferences.name: secondaryLanguage
preferences.title: Secondary Language
preferences.description: Used when the text is already in the primary language

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: OpenRouter model used for translations (must be on the key's allow-list)

preferences.name: copyQuickResult
preferences.title: Quick Translate
preferences.label: Copy translation to clipboard
preferences.description: Also copy the pill translation to the clipboard, so it survives after the pill fades
